Meta.description: Read webtoons, manga and manhwa published by their authors and teams. Rate, review and share your lists.

Accueil.videAide: Run “npm run db:demo” to load the demo series.

serie.titresAide: One per line: original title, translation, abbreviation. They are used by search.
serie.classificationAide: No sexually explicit content. 16+: violence or mature themes.
serie.droits: I declare that our team holds the rights to this work or the rights holder's permission to publish it.
serie.droitsAide: Required. A false declaration leads to removal of the series and may lead to suspension of the team.
serie.preuveNoteAide: Visible to the administration only: original author, licence, rights holder contact…
serie.preuveFichier: Attach proof of permission (PDF or image, optional)
serie.couvertureAide: Portrait image, at least 300 px wide. It is cropped to a 2:3 ratio.
serie.soumise: Series submitted. You will be told of the decision.
serie.aucunChapitre: No chapters. Add one to be able to submit the series.
serie.confirmerSuppression: Permanently delete this chapter and its pages?

chapitre.ajouter: Add images or a ZIP file
chapitre.ajouterAide: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, 25 MB per image, 300 pages at most. Long webtoon strips are split automatically.
chapitre.ordreAide: Drag the pages to change their order. This is the reading order.

Retrait.intro: Are you the author or rights holder of a work published here without your consent? Fill in this form: every request is reviewed promptly and you get an answer by email.
Retrait.representant: Authorised representative of the rights holder
Retrait.droitsAide: Describe how you hold the rights: author, publisher, licence agreement, registration… (at least 20 characters)
Retrait.urlsAide: One address per line, 30 at most.
Retrait.declaration: I declare on my honour that the information provided is accurate and that I am the rights holder or authorised to act on their behalf.
Retrait.envoyeeTexte: Your request has the reference {reference}. An acknowledgement has just been emailed to you.
